certificate.reason: pure measurement; no solve and no relation is claimed

reference_used: exhaustive key search only (definitional). NO literature figure was used to promote, dismiss, screen, rank or size anything in this package, in either direction.
anti_laundering_clause: Every margin below is stated against the DEFINITIONAL exhaustive-key-search reference for the named key size under the instrument's own stated charging model, and the comparison against the published state of the art is UNADJUDICABLE in this environment and is not asserted in either direction (RQ-AES-002 claim_tier_ceiling R5).

GATE_1_CAND_FR_1.object: the recomputation set of the AES-128 key-search computation graph
GATE_1_CAND_FR_1.enumeration: EXHAUSTIVE over all 65535 nonzero 16-bit key-difference SUPPORTS x all 11 splice points = 720885 cells per matrix (this strictly contains the pre-registered '16 single-byte plus a bounded set of multi-byte' delta set)

E1_vs_E2.signature_observed: NULL-1 (schedule randomised -> MORE diffusion) raises rho_min by +0.1500; NULL-2 (schedule = identity -> LESS diffusion) lowers it by 0.1138; the two SIBLING perturbations move rho_min in OPPOSITE directions, monotonically in schedule diffusion, so this is not 'any change to the schedule moves the number'. NULL-3 (MixColumns removed entirely, i.e. data-path diffusion destroyed) moves rho_min only 0.0600, a smaller move than either key-schedule perturbation.

void_condition.statement: rho_min must INCREASE as round count rises 4->10; the frozen rationale is that adding rounds can only ADD recomputable S-boxes under A1, i.e. it is about the COUNT
void_condition.verdict: DID NOT FIRE. The count is strictly increasing (+20 per round) AND the fraction is strictly increasing, so both readings of the condition pass and the ambiguity is not load-bearing.

GATE_1_CAND_FR_1.histograms: full count->frequency histograms for all four matrices are in gate1_raw_result.json (38/2/52/46 distinct bins over 720885 cells)
GATE_1_CAND_FR_1.NOT_AN_ATTACK: This is a combinatorial count under a conservative activity model. It models no matching, no biclique construction, no false-positive filtering, no data cost and no final verification. It is not a key recovery and not a distinguisher.

GATE_2_CAND_FR_2.object: q_r(delta,pi) = Pr_K[ pi(E_K^(r)(P)) = pi(E_{K+delta}^(r)(P)) ], used as an OFFLINE sieve
GATE_2_CAND_FR_2.oracle_use: NONE. Both branches are computed offline by the instrument; no related-key query is made, so the mechanism stays single-key-legitimate.

resolution.note: N below the pre-registered 2^22/2^30 because of the 1800 s task budget. The achieved floor is reported beside every reading, as the ideation requires. A null reading at this floor establishes the death round AT THIS FLOOR and nothing finer.

GATE_2_CAND_FR_2.death_round_definition: least r such that for all r' >= r the max |excess| over all 128 one-bit projections and all 16 eight-bit projections is < 5 sigma

prediction_scoring_against_the_FROZEN_pr.sibling_null_NULL_B_reads_the_same_as_re: YES, death rounds identical delta-for-delta -> the r<=3 excess is carried by BYTE ACTIVITY, not by the specific AES S-box

max_abs_excess_sigma_excluding_the_vacui.note: the expected max of ~144 standard normals is about 3 sigma, so every one of these is the null

falsification_conditions.excess_lt_5sigma_at_r=1_for_real_AES_ins: DID NOT FIRE (724.1 sigma at r=1)
falsification_conditions.q_not_exactly_1_at_delta=0: DID NOT FIRE (q = 1 exactly, every matrix, every convention, every r)

void_condition.statement: if the excess FAILS TO DECAY as r increases, for the real cipher or either null, every reading is void
void_condition.verdict: DID NOT FIRE. Every profile decays: real AES-128 falls from 724.1 sigma at r=1-2 to <5 sigma from r=3-4 onward and stays there through r=10.

E1_vs_E2_discriminator.pre_registered: E1 predicts AES-256, whose schedule diffuses more slowly, shows a LATER death round than AES-128 at the same round index; E2 predicts identical death rounds
E1_vs_E2_discriminator.observed: AES-256 death rounds 3-5 against AES-128 2-4; the three AES-256 deltas confined to the SECOND half of the master key (bytes 16,20,24) die at r=5, one round later than every AES-128 delta
E1_vs_E2_discriminator.verdict: E1 SUPPORTED, E2 NOT SUPPORTED, by this instrument at this resolution

independent_generator_crosscheck.generator: AES-CTR under the real cipher with an independent seed key
independent_generator_crosscheck.agrees_with_splitmix64_run: YES - same death-round structure (AES-128 3-4, AES-256 4-5, NULL-A 1, NULL-B = AES)

GATE_2_CAND_FR_2.interpretation_limit_verbatim_from_the_f: THE INSTRUMENT CANNOT DETECT AN EFFECT BELOW ITS RESOLUTION FLOOR. A real exploitable structure could easily sit at 2^-100. THEREFORE A NULL READING DOES NOT ESTABLISH THE ABSENCE OF EXPLOITABLE STRUCTURE AND MUST NEVER BE WRITTEN AS IF IT DID. Achieved floor here is 2^-7.18 relative for b=1, coarser than the pre-registered 2^-12.7 because N was 2^19 rather than 2^30.
GATE_2_CAND_FR_2.NOT_AN_ATTACK: No sieve is constructed and none could be: a usable sieve needs q > 1 - 2^-40 (assumption A2) and the measured q is at the null from r=4 onward.

what_this_package_does_NOT_establish: Nothing here asserts anything about AES security at any round count, in any threat model.
No distinguisher, no key recovery, no speedup, no barrier statement and no impossibility claim is made.
No comparison of any kind against the published state of the art is made, computed, or implied - in either direction.

GATE 1's 2^127.62 is a combinatorial activity count under a conservative model with A1-A4 charged as stated; it is NOT an attack and NOT a cost claim, and it is 7.27 bits ABOVE the derived class ceiling and 0.38 bits below the definitional exhaustive-search reference.
GATE 2's null readings at r>=4 establish the death round AT THE STATED RESOLUTION FLOOR and nothing finer.
The value-exact vs conservative activity gap (H1-FR1) was NOT measured; the attribution in GATE 1 is not protected against a differential bias in that gap between AES and NULL-1.
